# Race Place

> > Alpine ski racing equipment specialist featuring FIS-approved race suits, skis from Rossignol, Fischer, Atomic & Volkl, plus BEAST tuning tools developed in-house.

Family-owned ski shop founded in 1995 by Scott Holmer, creator of the Base BEAST edge bevel guide. Race Place specializes in competitive ski racing gear and offers professional tuning services from their Bend, Oregon location.

## Key Topics

- FIS-approved race equipment
- Alpine ski racing
- BEAST Tuning tools (Base BEAST, Side of BEAST, Plane BEAST)
- Race suits (Aspire, Spyder, Karbon, Arctica)
- Race skis (Rossignol, Fischer, Atomic, Volkl)
- Ski edge tuning & beveling
- Ski waxing techniques
- GS suits & speed suits
- Race ski preparation
- Professional ski tuning services
- Reusch racing gloves
- POC helmets
- Slalom & giant slalom equipment
- Junior racing gear
- FIS homologation
